segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Welcome to further education Information Week.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: This is the Physical Education Faculty's session and I'm the Head of the Faculty.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: During the course of this morning we hope to give you a clear idea of what we offer in our training programs and we will look at the types of courses and the entry requirements, if any, for those courses.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Some of these courses are open to school leavers, but for some you need previous qualifications, or relevant successful employment. - So firstly, the Physical Fitness Instructor's course is offered as a six-month certificate course which includes an important component of personal fitness but there are no specific entry requirements.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: For Sports Administrators we provide a four-month certificate course but you should be aware that this is designed for those who are in employment.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: This employment must be current and related to sports administration.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: For the Sports Psychologist course we offer a one-year diploma course, but this diploma course is available only to those who already hold a degree in psychology, so you need to make sure you have that before you apply to do this course.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Now . . . for Physical Education Teachers we offer a four-year degree in education.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: This degree course is designed for preparing students to teach in primary and secondary Schools and needs no prior qualifications as it is entered directly by school leavers.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: And lastly for the Recreation Officer's course we offer a six-month certificate.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Entry to this course normally includes applicants of a wide range of ages and experiences, but we do not insist on any prerequisites for this course.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Remember that this is a vocational training institute.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: We train you so that you can take up a particular kind of job.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: So it is important that you know the main roles of the jobs - what the work is like and what kind of qualities you need to succeed at them.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: A Physical Fitness Instructor works in health and fitness centres preparing individual programs for ordinary members of the public.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Physical Fitness Instructors prepare routines of exercises to suit the individual client's age and level of fitness.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Sports Administrators run clubs and sporting associations.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Their duties include such things as booking playing fields with local councils and organising the schedule of games or events for the club, so they need good organisational skills.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Sports Psychologists spend time with professional athletes helping them approach competition with a positive mental attitude to enable them to achieve their personal best.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: They do this by improving motivation and concentration or assisting with stress management.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Physical Education or PE Teachers instruct young students in how to exercise, play sport, and do other recreational activities correctly and safely.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: PE teachers help the development of co-ordination, balance, posture, and flexibility with things like simple catching and throwing skills.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: They are not expected to be experts in all sports, but must be able to show students the basic techniques involved in a wide range of activities.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Recreation Officers often find themselves working for local government authorities and local groups.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: Their aim is to raise people's awareness of healthy lifestyles and improved general fitness through arranging recreational activities for groups of all ages from the very young to the elderly.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: There are many other job opportunities which our graduates can look forward to.

segments.speaker: LECTURER
segments.en: If you are interested in any of these ...
